All tools/Text Formatter

Text Formatter

Clean up, transform and organize your text.

Your files stay yours. All processing happens on your device.

How to use this tool

  1. Paste the text you want to clean up.
  2. Choose a transformation; changes appear in the editor.
  3. Undo your last change or copy the result.

Good to know

Does letter case work in Arabic?

Arabic has no uppercase or lowercase. Case transformations affect Latin text; spacing and line tools work with both languages. Duplicate removal preserves the first exact occurrence.

Are my files or text uploaded?

Processing happens in your browser. Toolora does not send your files or text to a server. Close the page to clear the tool session.
